public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI lost $20.9 billion in 2025 on $13.07 billion in revenue.

statement.excerpt: Put simply, if Anthropic goes public with its own horrifying economics on parade, it’s hard to imagine OpenAI — a company that lost $20.9 billion in 2025 on $13.07 billion in revenue — will fare much better.

our_interpretation: Assess the financial observation, not the surrounding conditional discussion of an IPO.
Read an unqualified annual loss as net loss. This is an evaluator interpretation: the speaker did not specify operating loss, net loss, or cash burn.
Treat the figures as reported estimates from financial reporting, without imposing an unstated GAAP designation.
Allow rounding to the precision quoted.
criteria.support_condition: Reporting on comparable calendar-2025 financial records establishes revenue of $13.07 billion and net loss rounding to $20.9 billion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish a materially different revenue or net loss. An operating-loss figure cannot establish the net-loss component.
